ideas.topic: The Hidden Geometry of the Giza Slopes
ideas.hook: The Great Pyramid isn't just a tomb; it’s a masterclass in geometry that shouldn't have been possible 4,500 years ago.
ideas.why: It leverages the high performance of your existing 'truncated pyramid' video while tapping into the viral 'Pyramid Theory' interest.

ideas.topic: Why Cats Were Only Half the Story: Ancient Egypt's Wild Pets
ideas.hook: We all know Egyptians worshipped cats, but would you have kept a pet baboon or a hyena in your living room?
ideas.why: It mirrors the high-performing 'Dogs in ancient paintings' topic by focusing on the surprising, relatable reality of daily domestic life.

ideas.topic: The Pharaoh's Makeup: More Than Just Vanity
ideas.hook: That iconic black eyeliner worn by Tutankhamun wasn't just for style—it was a literal medical shield against the Nile sun.
ideas.why: It uses a 'myth vs. reality' angle similar to the popular Cleopatra appearance videos but anchors it in historical science.
